references.text: Here a prophecy is mentioned that the Lord will send a messenger before him, which can be seen as a prediction of Jesus' entry into Jerusalem.
This verse contains a blessing for the one who comes in the name of the Lord, which is reflected in Jesus' entry into Jerusalem.
Paul mentions faith and love that spring from hope, which can be related to Jesus' entry as a symbol of hope.
This is a direct fulfillment of the prophecy in Zechariah 9:9 about a king coming riding on a donkey, which underscores Jesus' role as the Messiah.
